summary: Implemented an /admin route with an Internet Identity login gate and admin-only access, added frontend hooks to fetch/update backend-stored page content with fallback defaults, and wired Home + Admissions/Footer contact fields to backend content. Backend gained page content storage and admin-guarded update methods. However, the diff shows a prohibited modification to an immutable frontend hook path and introduces several unrequested access-control/token utilities and backend methods.

missing_requirements.requirement: There is a way to establish/maintain at least one admin principal (e.g., initial admin set on first use and/or admin list management restricted to admins).
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows admin permission checks via AccessControl/MixinAuthorization, but the diff does not show any explicit method to add an initial admin or manage the admin list (e.g., addAdmin/removeAdmin) or describe a first-use bootstrap mechanism within main.mo itself.

hallucinated_features.description: Edited an explicitly immutable file path (frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts) to add actor initialization logic and secret-token based access-control initialization.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraints state not to edit frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts; diff modifies it and adds unrequested token bootstrap behavior (caffeineAdminToken).

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a secret URL/session parameter utility module for persisting URL parameters and removing them from hash (admin token/session helpers).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; also suggests secret-token handling beyond the stated Internet Identity-only authentication non-goal.

hallucinated_features.description: Added backend methods beyond requested public read + admin write: removePage, getAllPages (admin-only), and getPages (batch read).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-11 only asked for a public query to fetch the current site content model and an admin-restricted update method; these extra endpoints were not requested.
